MY 4 DAY UPPER/LOWER 💪 (save this post!)

MON — Upper Strength
Bench press 4 sets of 6 @ RPE 8
Weighted pull-ups 4 sets of 6
Overhead press 3 sets of 8
Barbell row 3 sets of 8

TUE — Lower Strength
Back squat 4 sets of 5 @ RPE 8
Romanian deadlift 3 sets of 8
Walking lunges 3 sets of 12
Hanging leg raises 3 sets of 15

THU — Upper Hypertrophy
Incline dumbbell press 4 sets of 10-12
Lat pulldown 4 sets of 12
Cable lateral raise 3 sets of 15
EZ bar curl 3 sets of 12

FRI — Lower Hypertrophy
Leg press 4 sets of 12
Leg curl 4 sets of 12
Hip thrust 4 sets of 10
Calf raises 4 sets of 15
